atoms.b: What is going to school in the ((++1900s 2400s)) like?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>What is going to school in the 1900s like?</prosody>

atoms.b: School is very different for boys and girls. We all learn to ((++read skip)) and write, but girls also have to learn how to be a housewife.
A housewife is a woman who stays at ((++home shops)) and takes care of the chores and the children.
Girls in the early 1900s are expected to ((++get_married run_around)) and become housewives instead of working, so school prepares us for this life.
It sounds very ((++unfair incredible)) that girls did not get to choose what to do with their lives.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>It sounds very unfair that girls did not get to choose what to do with their lives.</prosody>

feedback.end: These unfair differences in education lasted for many years. In the 1960s, only 30% of all university students were women!
